_comment: Public agent repositories used to measure precision and recall. Commits are pinned so a number in the README refers to a specific tree that anyone can check out. Subdirs keep clone size and scan time reasonable while still covering the registration shapes each framework actually uses. Entries with a `clone` key share one checkout. Repositories where the scanner is KNOWN to miss are included on purpose: recall below 1.00 is the honest number.

repos.name: strands-tools
repos.why: Canonical dangerous tools: a PTY shell reaching os.execvp, a Python REPL reaching exec(), and an AWS tool using dynamic dispatch.

repos.name: pydantic-ai-examples
repos.why: agent.run() delegation everywhere, plus @agent.tool_plain registration. The false-positive corpus.

repos.name: smolagents
repos.why: @tool decorated functions; docstrings mentioning secrets on read-only tools.

repos.name: agno-hitl
repos.why: Tools with requires_confirmation=True. Framework-native human-in-the-loop that was reported as ungoverned.

repos.name: awslabs-mcp-iam
repos.why: Real boto3 IAM calls behind FastMCP tools: the true-positive corpus.

repos.name: awslabs-mcp-ecs
repos.why: FastMCP tools whose destructive call lives one import away (modules/delete.py -> api/delete.py -> cloudformation.delete_stack). The cross-module gap, labelled as a known miss.

repos.name: awslabs-mcp-eks
repos.why: Tools registered as self.mcp.tool(name=...)(self.method) on a handler class, with the Kubernetes calls in another module. Registration is recognised; the sink is not reached.

repos.name: awslabs-mcp-aws-api
repos.why: call_aws executes arbitrary AWS CLI commands. destructiveHint is a runtime expression, not a literal, and the execution lives in core/aws/service.py. The most consequential tool in the corpus, and a known miss.

repos.name: openhands-tools
repos.why: A coding agent whose terminal tool is a ToolExecutor subclass with __call__; the Popen lives in terminal/subprocess_terminal.py. Reachability is recognised, the sink is cross-module: a known miss.
